title: Mico Homepage Content

fields.label: Hero Headline
fields.name: hero_headline
fields.instructions: Big headline over the campus photo. Default: Do It With Thy Might

fields.label: Hero Paragraph
fields.name: hero_body
fields.instructions: Intro paragraph under the hero headline.
fields.default_value: Founded in 1836, Mico University has spent generations turning curiosity into achievement. From student-led research to athletics and civic leadership, Mico prepares the next wave of doers.

fields.label: Hero Background Image
fields.name: hero_image
fields.instructions: Full-width hero background. Leave empty to use the bundled default photo.

fields.label: Curiosity Section — Paragraph 1
fields.name: curiosity_body1
fields.default_value: With more than 180 degree programs across 10 colleges, Mico offers a path for every ambition — a research lab, a courtroom, a clinic, a stage or a startup.

fields.label: Curiosity Section — Paragraph 2
fields.name: curiosity_body2
fields.default_value: At Mico, learning goes beyond the classroom. Work alongside faculty researchers, gain hands-on field experience and contribute to discoveries shaping health, technology and community.

fields.label: Curiosity Section — Image
fields.name: curiosity_image
fields.instructions: Right-hand photo. Leave empty for the neutral placeholder.

fields.label: Waiting Section — Paragraph
fields.name: waiting_body
fields.default_value: From the moment you step on campus, Mico feels like home. You'll challenge yourself, find support from a community that believes in your potential and connect with people who become lifelong friends.

fields.label: Stat 2 — Label
fields.name: stat2_label
fields.default_value: Clubs, academic associations and professional organizations

fields.label: Research Banner — Paragraph
fields.name: research_body
fields.default_value: At Mico, research isn't a headline — it's a habit. With growing investment across health, environment and technology, faculty and students are turning ideas into impact.

fields.label: CTA Banner — Heading
fields.name: cta_heading
fields.default_value: Take the next step with Mico

description: Editable content for the Mico headless homepage. Empty fields fall back to the built-in defaults on astro.websage.lat.
